title: Framework Ui Family Crate Consolidation
description:
This is part of W8b ("Framework wave", family batch) in the approved plan `/Users/ueli/.claude/plans/the-codebase-still-has-spicy-umbrella.md` — read it in full first, especially "Key merges" → "UI", "Hard ordering constraints" C9 ("ui-react move + storybook regen same pass"), and the "M9 generated storybook config" note in the master doc (search for it — it just landed and is directly relevant to you).

CONTEXT — read in full, in this order:
1. The spicy-umbrella plan file above.
2. `.🦑️repo/🎫️tickets/🎆️26/🌙️08/☀️05/CRATE-CONSOLIDATION-AND-PLUGIN-TAXONOMY-RESTRUCTURE/📋️master.md` — read in FULL, especially the recent M1-M9 mechanism-wave notes (search "M1 DONE", "M2 done", "M9 done") — M9 just built a generator for `.storybook/scopes.ts`/`main.ts` driven by M1's `discoverPackages()` plus an opt-in `"semio":{"storybook":{...}}` marker; your ui-react move MUST land in lockstep with a storybook regen per hard constraint C9, using that new generator/opt-in mechanism rather than hand-editing scopes.ts. Also read the many notes about the pre-existing, out-of-scope "dangling Anta font path" bug that blocks full storybook BUILDS repo-wide (do not attempt to fix it — several prior tickets have already deliberately left it alone).
3. `.🦑️repo/🎫️tickets/🎆️26/🌙️08/☀️05/CRATE-CONSOLIDATION-AND-PLUGIN-TAXONOMY-RESTRUCTURE/📋️TEMPLATE.md` — the taxonomy shape conventions.
4. `🧰️framework/🛍️products/🦑️repo/🔨️modules/📚️lib/⚡️implementations/🟦️typescript/🔣️taxonomy.json` and `🟦️discovery.ts` — shared vocabulary/discovery.
5. The current `🖱️ui/` directory tree in full — tui, wgpu (rust), ui-react (the 41k-line single `📦️index.tsx`), ui-styling (TS + python), renderer-react (32k single file), and any dotnet remnants.

YOUR TASK: consolidate `🖱️ui/`'s Rust crates (tui + wgpu targets) into ONE `semio-framework-ui` crate with cargo FEATURES `tui`/`wgpu`/`typegen` (this is the ONE place in the whole initiative where features beat separate modules, per the plan — because the dependency weight differs radically between targets; do not try to force this into the taxonomy-tree-of-modules pattern used everywhere else). Structure: `🖱️ui/📦️packages/🦀️rust/` with `🎯️targets/{🖥️tui,🧊️wgpu}/` subdirs (this repo already uses a `🎯️targets/<target>/` convention — confirmed present in `ui-wgpu`'s current path `📦️packages/🦀️rust/🎯️targets/🧊️wgpu/📦️lib.rs`, read that file first to understand the EXISTING target-split convention before touching anything).

For the TS side: `@semio-tech/ui-react` keeps its name at `🖱️ui/⚛️react/` — the plan is explicit that **the 41k-line `📦️index.tsx` moves AS-IS; splitting it is a separately-ticketed future follow-up, NOT your job**. Same for `renderer-react` (32k single file) if it lives under this same family — move the file, do not split it. `@semio-tech/ui-styling` (TS) stays; its python sibling (`📦️packages/🐍️python/pyproject.toml`) stays too but **delete its checked-in `.venv`** (the plan explicitly calls this out as dead weight — confirm it's genuinely a python venv directory, not something else, before deleting). Delete any empty dotnet csproj you find (confirm it's genuinely empty/unused first).

**The storybook coordination (C9)**: once ui-react moves, its OLD sourceRoot in `.storybook/scopes.ts`'s hand-curated entries (or wherever it currently lives) becomes stale. Read M9's new generator (`.storybook/scopes.ts`'s `GENERATED_SCOPES` + the `readSemioMarkerSubTable()` opt-in mechanism in `🟦️discovery.ts`) and either (a) opt ui-react's new `package.json` into the generated-scopes mechanism via a `"semio":{"storybook":{...}}` key, moving it out of `HAND_CURATED_SCOPES`, or (b) if it still needs to stay hand-curated for a good reason (cross-owner sourceRoots, custom vite plugins — check the current hand-curated list for why entries stay there), update its sourceRoot literal in the SAME commit as the file move. Do not leave scopes.ts pointing at a deleted path even momentarily across your own tool calls.

VERIFICATION: `cargo check --workspace` scoped to your new crate + wasm32-wasip2 target, `cargo clippy`, existing tests preserved. For TS: whatever `ui-react:check`/`typecheck` targets exist, run them; confirm the storybook scopes.ts change is internally consistent (a static check, since the full build is blocked by the known font bug — don't try to work around that). Run the registry taxonomy check to confirm framework-role discovery.

CONSTRAINTS (non-negotiable, exclusive ownership of `🖱️ui/**` only):
- Never touch root Cargo.toml/Cargo.lock, root package.json workspaces, nx.json, .dependency-cruiser.cjs, the registry script/generated output, .vscode/launch.json, any plugin directory, or any OTHER framework family's directory (math, compiler [skip — blocked by an open human ticket], surface, hash/editor/schema, assets, os/kernel/host).
- You MAY edit `.storybook/scopes.ts`/`main.ts`/`globals.css` — this is explicitly required by C9's same-pass coordination rule, just via M9's generator/opt-in mechanism where possible rather than a manual hand-edit that would immediately go stale.
- Never run git-modifying commands or use git worktrees.
- Do NOT use `run_in_background: true` for Bash — run synchronously with generous timeouts (600s+).
- Delete any temporary verification overlay + nested target/Cargo.lock BEFORE closing your ticket — this class of leftover has repeatedly broken root `cargo metadata` this initiative.
- Add temporary files to your own ticket folder.
- When finished, call `mcp__repo__ticket_close` with a full summary and file list, plus a registrar-handoff block (root Cargo.toml lines to remove/add). Do not touch any other ticket.

Report back a concise summary of your architecture decisions (especially the feature-flag structure and the storybook coordination), what you deliberately did NOT split (index.tsx, renderer-react), and your verification results.
